_comment: Copy to sources.json. Only enter facts you know - nothing here is guessed by the system. trust_score is YOUR 0-1 rating of the store.

stores.name: חנות ישראלית לדוגמה
stores._comment: ask the store for the XML feed it gives price-comparison sites; map unusual tags with xml_mapping

stores.name: Example Store
stores._comment_search: search_url = the store's own search page ({q} = the words); used by `py main.py search` and the app's search box. Optional: search_include (product-URL regex on that page) and search_selector (CSS selector of the result-card links, for stores whose product URLs have no fixed shape)

affiliate.note: where you saw it, the commission if published

stores._comment_search_sitemap: A store whose robots.txt forbids its search page (Disallow: /*?s=) but lists product sitemaps with the product name in each URL: put "search_sitemap": "https://store.example/" (and search_include, e.g. "/product/") instead of search_url - a search then looks for the words in the sitemaps' product URLs.
stores._comment_affiliate: affiliate = what you KNOW about the store's own affiliate program. status: confirmed (a published program page - put it in url), signs (an affiliate app on the site, no public sign-up), not_found (looked, found nothing). The app's 'only stores with an affiliate program' filter uses confirmed + signs + the programs you set up in its affiliate programs tab.
